process_templated_generations: run the script to parse raw templated command blocks and split them into train and validation datasets
parse_raw_templated_data: run the script with --raw_templated_path to parse multi-line command blocks separated by blank lines into pipe-delimited examples
split_train_valid: run the script to split parsed templated examples into an 80/20 train and validation set
write_ground_truth: run the script with --ground_truth_path to write all parsed examples to a ground truth output file
review_data_processing_script: review the script that processes templated generations for NSP transformer model training data preparation
